name: Crypt of the Eternals
description: The grand necropolis of Amonkhet beyond the Gate to the Afterlife, where the worthy dead were transformed into Eternals.

description_citations.text: "Crypt of the Eternals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The worthy dead are carried through the gate on funerary barges, embalmed, coated in lazotep and fitted with weapons to become Eternals.
timeline.quote: The truly worthy dead, however, received far greater honor.

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Final Hours the sealed gates swing open as the Second Sun aligns with the horns of the monument, revealing an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: the sealed gates finally swung open as foretold when the Second Sun aligned with the horns of the God-Pharaoh's monument

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Chandra visits the crypt, destroys a stay band of Eternals and obliterates the statue of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: then obliterated the massive statue of Nicol Bolas inside the crypt

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During New Phyrexia's invasion of the multiverse the crypt is opened by the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: During New Phyrexia's invasion of the multiverse, it was opened by the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
